system.description:
• Personally tutored by a single master wizard rather than enrolled in any institution: no lecture hall, no cohort, just a master's direct attention and very high expectations.
  • Steady Hand: Advantage on saves against your own spells' backlash or unintended effects. When you fail to keep a spell after being damaged while casting, you keep its slot.
  • Myllnoris Standing: Advantage on checks navigating Myllnoris's arcane bureaucracy or identifying Myllnoris-made magic items.
